item.title: About Project Blue
item.description: Project Blue is the name of this blog as you might’ve figured this out already! The only thing special about this blog is that I’ve designed this blog bottom up by myself (except using Bootstrap for quick themeing). There’s nothing much to tell you about this blog yet but I’ll figure something amazing to tell when this blog gets some direction and then write it here! :=D

item.title: About Me
item.description: Hi! I’m Siddharth Mishra aka @brightprogrammer! I love Reverse Engineering and Software Development. I generally use C/C++ but nowadays my inclination is towards C in order to test whether we can avoid object oriented programming to solve any problem thrown at us. I’m a Mathematics & Computing student from India and I love Mathematics too! Nowadays I’m into Abstract Algebra like : Group Theory Linear Algebra Graph Theory I have a bucket list of things I want to create on my own from scratch in order to get the thrill of it :
